problem_statement: Let g be Arnold simple-elliptic type X9 with Milnor lattice M of rank 9, radical R of rank 2, published Gabrielov intersection form and Seifert form L. Let u0 be the canonical isotropic vector from the longest-root-plus-extra construction and u1 a second explicit isotropic vector from the radical basis. No braid-group word is evaluated; monodromy acts via O(M). Decide whether u0 has Seifert divisibility gcd{L(u0,x):x in M}=2 and lies in a distinct monodromy orbit from u1 certified by a separating Seifert invariant, versus u0 having divisibility 1 with an explicit g in the monodromy group sending u0 to u1.
